mirrorImage.label: Mirror Image

descriptions.cleave: If the target is within 5 ft of another creature in your reach, you may attack that second creature with the same weapon (no ability modifier to that damage).
descriptions.graze: Miss with this weapon? The target still takes damage equal to the ability modifier you used to attack.
descriptions.nick: When you make the extra attack of the Light property, you can make it as part of the Attack action instead of as a Bonus Action.
descriptions.push: You can push the target 10 feet straight away from you.
descriptions.sap: The target has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.
descriptions.slow: The target's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
descriptions.topple: The target must succeed on a Constitution save (DC 8 + PB + your STR/DEX mod) or be knocked Prone.
descriptions.vex: You have Advantage on your next attack roll against the target before the end of your next turn.
descriptions.flex: Versatile stance — alternate between one-handed and two-handed damage dice.
